about: The kinds of room the level generator makes (js/rules/levelgen/): the dungeon rooms' kinds, and the kinds of the goblin king's halls. Each kind's furnishing is a function in a table (js/rules/levelgen/kinds.js, halls.js); here, what they need to be chosen and lit. Read by js/rules/levelgen/make.js.

fields.weight: how likely, against the others that fit (a level's settings can change it: the levels mockup's sliders)
fields.fits: where it fits, in squares: short, the room's shorter way at least; long, its longer way at least; longEven, its longer way even; even, both ways even; squarish, its two ways no more than this apart. None: anywhere
fields.light: how it's lit, if it's one of the rooms lit: candles on the altar; a brazier at an end; at an end, or in the middle of a small one; braziers down the middle; in the middle (two, in a long room). The layouts: js/rules/levelgen/kinds.js
fields.columns: false: never held up by columns (it has posts of its own)
fields.recesses: false: never recesses in its walls
fields.rank: a hall's: the lower, the sooner it's chosen when it fits (the rarer kinds first)
fields.placed: a hall's that isn't chosen by fit: where it goes instead

plain.about: a few things in the corners, now and then

store.about: shelves along a wall or two, crates and barrels in the corners

hall.about: filled with posts, half posts on the walls

crypt.about: niches round the walls with coffins, a sarcophagus in a bigger one

jail.about: cells behind a wall, each with a door and a bench

barracks.about: beds in rows along the long walls

dining.about: tables with chairs either side, in rows

shrine.about: an altar against a wall with no way in, posts either side

A.about: two rows of columns along the long way

F.about: split by a wall of rock with gaps in it

C.about: round, a ring of columns, cut clean

I.placed: the smallest hall, when there are four or more
I.about: a storeroom: stacks of crates and barrels

K.placed: the hall most by the caverns
K.about: begun in a cave, squared off at the other end

L.placed: the throne room: the biggest hall in the far third, on a level with a throne
L.about: a nave of columns leading to an apse where the king sits
